title: cardamine atlantica
intro: Cardamine atlantica, commonly known as the Atlantic bittercress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is known to have various health benefits, including its ability to support the immune system and have anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in reducing symptoms of conditions such as arthritis. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine atlantica include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may also help in protecting against cell damage and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates and other glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide protection against certain diseases.
